# Environment Variables

This package uses environment variables. The schema for these variables is as follows:

| Variable                    | Description                                              | Type   | Required |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | -------- |
| AZURE_HOT_BLOB_STORAGE_URL  | Azure Blob Storage account URL for the Hot access tier.  | string |          |
| AZURE_COOL_BLOB_STORAGE_URL | Azure Blob Storage account URL for the Cool access tier. | string |          |
| AZURE_COLD_BLOB_STORAGE_URL | Azure Blob Storage account URL for the Cold access tier. | string |          |
